Used for tumbling, smoothing, and polishing rough stones into shiny gemstones.

A black motorized base unit featuring dual digital control knobs for days and speed settings with red LED readouts, holding a black rolling barrel tilted slightly on its side.

Used for advanced lapidary rock polishing with multiple custom speed and timer settings.

Intended to be placed inside the tumbling barrels along with water and polishing grit to be transformed into smooth gemstones.

Raw, unpolished, and structurally intact.
